Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the confirmation. Important heads-up: our security team just flagged that external Meet invites are blocked by a new SSO enforcement policy — attendees in a few groups won't be able to enter Meet links that originate outside CloudPark.

Most of our engineers will try to join from GSuite and may get a "cannot join external meeting" error. Can you send a Zoom link (or a dial-in) instead so we avoid last-minute join failures? Procurement is copied because they may need to join for the SOW discussion.

Also can you include me (daniel.lee@cloudpark.com) and my engineering lead (sarah.james@cloudpark.com) explicitly on the calendar invite? Sometimes auto-forwarding strips organizer rights.

Appreciate the quick fix.
Daniel
Director, Cloud Integrations
CloudPark

https://us02web.zoom.us/j/98374561234?pwd=demo

—Naomi
